root_cause.text: During RAID456 reshape, I/O requests that cross the reshape position can block in `raid5_make_request()` waiting for reshape progress while holding an `active_io` reference, which prevents `mddev_suspend()` from draining all references when the reshape thread is frozen, causing a deadlock.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and commit message state: "direct IO across the reshape position can sleep in raid5_make_request() waiting for reshape progress while still holding an active_io reference... mddev_suspend() kills active_io and waits for all in-flight IO to drain... This can deadlock: the IO needs reshape progress to continue, but the reshape thread is already frozen, so the active_io reference is never dropped and suspend never completes." The patch adds a call to `mddev->pers->prepare_suspend(mddev)` when `reshape_interrupted(mddev)` before waiting for active_io to drain, which wakes the waiters to break the deadlock.
